questionEn: What characteristic refers to the concept of “dissolution”?
choicesEn: process of transition from solid (ice) to liquid state
process of transition of vapor into liquid state
the process of water changing from liquid to solid (ice)
the process of changing from a liquid or solid state to a vapor state (water from ice to steam)
choicesUz: qattiq (muz) holatidan suyuq holatga o'tish jarayoni
suvning suyuqlikdan qattiq holatga (muz) o'tish jarayoni
suyuq yoki qattiq holatdan bug 'holatiga o'tish jarayoni (suv muzdan bug'ga)
explanationEn: Dissolution is the process of transition from a solid (ice) to a liquid state.
explanationUz: Eritma - qattiq (muz) dan suyuq holatga o'tish jarayoni.
